title: SpaceX plans to invest $50B in an Arizona data center campus and $24B in a Texas campus; in October, it said its AI business generated 50%+ of its revenue (Grace Kay/New York Times)
summary: Grace Kay / New York Times: SpaceX plans to invest $50B in an Arizona data center campus and $24B in a Texas campus; in October, it said its AI business generated 50%+ of its revenue — Elon Musk's rocket and artificial intelligence company has spent billions to develop the giant warehouses full of computer servers that power the technology.
